  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the ES-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Longstanding card use makes legitimate foreign-card ownership with an address mismatch plausible, but does not establish who ordered. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under the adverse-family row and perform id_check. Contact is not required. The order has already shipped, so verification cannot pause shipment or prevent the existing exposure. Decline is not permitted on this unresolved sole-family evidence."
